EVTDESC_HF_49207;It seems I have waited too long
column2: as my men and all my preparation starts to come apart. It seems people lost faith in my plans
column3: when I did not start any wars for our rightful Marianne.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49212;Magnanimous [Root.GetTitledName]\n\nYour plans to reconquer France for our rightful Marianne inspires me to take up arms as well
column2: and I will support your efforts to the best of my ability.\n\nYour ally
column3: \n[From.GetTitledName];;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49220;After leading troops on both sides of the wars raging throughout France
column2: I seem to have grown quite the reputation among the local peasants and soldiers on both sides.\n\nThough some would consider me a mercenary or a traitor to the faith
column3: my prowess in war has made me a hero among most
column4: and revered among the populace. Some would even go as far as to call me a folk hero.\n\nSurely
column5: my actions must have been righteous
column6: seeing all the responses. I have often wondered if it would all be worth it in the end
column7: and it is a joyous occasion to see all my hard work has paid off.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTTITLE_HF_49221;The Jacobin Hero;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_HF_49221;I have fought for the faith several times these recent years
column2: to recapture the kingdoms of France as a true vanguard for our rightful Marianne and her followers.\n\nThough we were once defeated by the heathens
column3: who had reasserted their ancient heathen beliefs in the chaos after the Event
column4: we have once again brought them under the rule of Marianne. Step by step
column5: we have regained what is rightfully ours.\n\nThe kingdoms of France will rise as a bastion of our rightful Marianne once more. We will make sure of it.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49232;To the greedy [Root.GetTitledName]\n\nYour despicable offer disgusts me. I hope to see you at the battlefield next
column2: so I can cut you down together with the rest of the heathens.\n\nSigned
column3: \n[From.GetTitledName];;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49233;[Root.GetTitledName]\n\nYour prowess in war is well known throughout France
column2: and I would like to offer you a sum of gold for your services in the current Maquis War.\n\nSigned
column3: \n[From.GetTitledName];;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49241;There will probably be men showing up to fight for the faith in the upcoming wars for France
column2: but I could invest some money into spreading the message far and wide to attract more well trained troops.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTDESC_HF_49249;A year has passed since I started my preparations for the reconquest of France
column2: and I am sure that whoever wanted to take part in the reconquest would have arrived by now. Now all that remains is to find a place to point my newfound allies towards.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTTITLE_HF_49450;The Jacobin Maquis Wars;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTDESC_HF_49450;As the last in a long line of attempts to try to reconquer the kingdoms of France
column2: [From.GetTitledName] has begun preparing [From.GetHerHis] troops and looking for allies for a new Jacobin campaign. Trying to restore parts of France to Marianne
column3: [From.GetTitledFirstName] has spent a noticeable amount of resources and sent out a call to gather troops from all around the region.\n\nWith the Jacobins planning for war
column4: the other faiths have started assembling their troops to defend themselves. It is only a matter of months
column5: or maybe a year
column6: before the two sides will clash together once more
column7: desperately trying to claw their way to more land in France.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

column1: EVTOPTA_HF_49450;France belongs to Marianne!;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTOPTB_HF_49450;This French nonsense does not belong here!;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
EVTTITLE_HF_49452;End of the Maquis;;;;;;;;;;;;;x

EVTDESC_HF_49452;Not even the most isolated heathen bastions have been safe from the Jacobin reconquest of Mexico. The final bastions of the other faiths in the region has fallen.\n\nWith France finally restored to the faithful
column2: the reconquest of the empire has ended
column3: and peace has been restored. Once more the center of the faith
column4: the kingdoms of France will surely play an important role in the region.;;;;;;;;;;;;;x
